<content><![CDATA[import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { EmotionalMode } from '../types';

interface ThreeCanvasProps {
  analyser: React.MutableRefObject<AnalyserNode | null>;
  videoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement>;
  emotionalMode: EmotionalMode;
}

const ThreeCanvas: React.FC<ThreeCanvasProps> = ({ analyser, videoRef, emotionalMode }) => {
  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stateRef = useRef({ emotionalMode });

  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current = { emotionalMode };
  }, [emotionalMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mountRef.current) return;

    let scene: THREE.Scene, camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer;
    let ynoLogoPlane: THREE.Mesh;
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    let animationId: number;
    
    // Environment Elements
    let terrain1: THREE.Mesh, terrain2: THREE.Mesh;
    let cyberSunGroup: THREE.Group;
    let stars: THREE.Points;
    let floatingData: THREE.InstancedMesh;
    const DATA_COUNT = 200;
    
    // Robot definitions
    interface Robot {
        group: THREE.Group;
        headGroup: THREE.Group;
        eyesMaterial: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
        coreMaterial: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
        // Flight Path State
        path: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
        progress: number; // 0 to 1
        speed: number;
        // Visuals
        trailPositions: THREE.Vector3[];
        trailLine: THREE.Line;
        // Interaction state
        isInteract: boolean;
        interactStartTime: number;
    }
    let robots: Robot[] = [];
    
    // Audio Data
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(256);

    // Color Themes
    const modeThemes: Record<EmotionalMode, { 
        sky: number, 
        grid: number, 
        sun: number, 
        robot: number,
        fogDensity: number
    }> = {
      Professional: { sky: 0x050510, grid: 0x8A2BE2, sun: 0x00FFFF, robot: 0x00FFFF, fogDensity: 0.015 },
      Enthusiastic: { sky: 0x1a0a00, grid: 0xFF4500, sun: 0xFFD700, robot: 0xFFD700, fogDensity: 0.01 },
      Cautious: { sky: 0x001a0a, grid: 0x006400, core: 0x00FF00, robot: 0x20B2AA, fogDensity: 0.02 },
      Zen: { sky: 0x101015, grid: 0xFFB6C1, core: 0xE6E6FA, robot: 0xFF69B4, fogDensity: 0.01 }
    };

    const playInteractionSound = () => {
        try {
            const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
            const ctx = new AudioContext();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1200, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
            
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
            
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
        } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
    };

    const init = () => {
      scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x050510);
      scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x050510, 0.015);

      camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
      camera.position.set(0, 3, 10);
      camera.lookAt(0, 0, -20);

      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
      if (mountRef.current) {
        mountRef.current.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
      }

      // Lights
      const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 2);
      scene.add(ambientLight);
      
      const sunLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff, 1, 100);
      sunLight.position.set(0, 20, -50);
      scene.add(sunLight);

      // --- ENVIRONMENT ---
      createStarfield();
      createInfiniteTerrain();
      createCyberSun();
      createFloatingData();
      createYnoAssets();
      
      // --- ROBOTS ---
      const path1 = generateComplexPath(20, 10, 0); 
      const path2 = generateComplexPath(15, 15, Math.PI);
      const path3 = generateComplexPath(25, 8, Math.PI / 2);
      
      createRobot(path1, 0.0);
      createRobot(path1, 0.5);
      createRobot(path2, 0.25);
      createRobot(path2, 0.75);
      createRobot(path3, 0.1);
    };

    const createStarfield = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const count = 2000;
        const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
        
        for(let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            positions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400;
            positions[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200 + 50;
            positions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 400 - 100;
        }
        
        geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
        const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff,
            size: 0.5,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.8,
            sizeAttenuation: true
        });
        
        stars = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
        scene.add(stars);
    };

    const generateComplexPath = (width: number, height: number, offset: number): THREE.CatmullRomCurve3 => {
        const points: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
        const segmentCount = 12;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
            const t = (i / segmentCount) * Math.PI * 2 + offset;
            const x = Math.sin(t) * width + Math.sin(t * 3) * 5;
            const y = Math.cos(t * 2) * (height / 2) + 5; 
            const z = Math.cos(t) * 20 - 25; 
            
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
        }
        
        return new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
    };

    const generateTerrainGeometry = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(250, 250, 50, 50);
        geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        
        const positions = geometry.attributes.position.array as Float32Array;
        for(let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
            const x = positions[i];
            const distFromCenter = Math.abs(x);
            // More interesting terrain noise
            const height = Math.sin(x * 0.1) * 3 + Math.cos(x * 0.5) * 1 + (Math.random() * 2);
            positions[i + 1] = (distFromCenter > 15 ? height + (distFromCenter - 15) * 0.8 : height * 0.1) - 15;
        }
        geometry.computeVertexNormals();
        return geometry;
    };

    const createInfiniteTerrain = () => {
        const geometry = generateTerrainGeometry();
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: 0x000000,
            emissive: modeThemes.Professional.grid,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
            wireframe: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.4
        });

        terrain1 = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        terrain1.position.z = -50;
        
        terrain2 = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        terrain2.position.z = -300;

        scene.add(terrain1);
        scene.add(terrain2);
    };

    const createCyberSun = () => {
        cyberSunGroup = new THREE.Group();
        cyberSunGroup.position.set(0, 20, -100);
        scene.add(cyberSunGroup);

        // Main geometric core
        const geometry = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(15, 1);
        const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: modeThemes.Professional.sun,
            wireframe: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.9
        });
        const sunMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        cyberSunGroup.add(sunMesh);
        
        // Inner intense glow
        const glowGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(10, 32, 32);
        const glowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5
        });
        const glow = new THREE.Mesh(glowGeo, glowMat);
        cyberSunGroup.add(glow);

        // Outer halo rings
        const ringGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(25, 0.5, 16, 100);
        const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: modeThemes.Professional.sun, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3 });
        const ring1 = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
        ring1.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        cyberSunGroup.add(ring1);
        
        const ring2 = ring1.clone();
        ring2.rotation.x = Math.PI / 3;
        ring2.scale.set(0.8, 0.8, 0.8);
        cyberSunGroup.add(ring2);
    };

    const createFloatingData = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 2, 0.5);
        const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4 });
        floatingData = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, DATA_COUNT);
        
        const dummy = new THREE.Object3D();
        for(let i=0; i<DATA_COUNT; i++) {
            dummy.position.set(
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120,
                -20 + Math.random() * 60,
                -150 + Math.random() * 100
            );
            dummy.scale.setScalar(0.5 + Math.random());
            dummy.updateMatrix();
            floatingData.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
        }
        scene.add(floatingData);
    };

    const createRobot = (path: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3, startProgress: number) => {
        const group = new THREE.Group();
        
        // Robot styling - Sleeker
        const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: 0x111111, roughness: 0.2, metalness: 0.9 
        });
        const glowMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: 0x00ffff, emissive: 0x00ffff, emissiveIntensity: 2 
        });

        const torso = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.5, 2.5, 8), bodyMat);
        torso.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; 
        group.add(torso);
        
        const engine = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.4), glowMat);
        engine.position.z = 1.2;
        group.add(engine);

        const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
        headGroup.position.set(0, 0.4, -0.8);
        group.add(headGroup);

        const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.4, 0.6), bodyMat);
        headGroup.add(head);

        const eyeGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08);
        const leftEye = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, glowMat);
        leftEye.position.set(-0.15, 0, -0.35);
        headGroup.add(leftEye);
        const rightEye = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, glowMat);
        rightEye.position.set(0.15, 0, -0.35);
        headGroup.add(rightEye);

        const wingGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        // Custom wing shape
        const wingVertices = new Float32Array([
            0, 0, 0,
            2, 0, 1,
            0, 0, 0.5,
            -2, 0, 1,
            0, 0, 0.5,
            0, 0, 0
        ]);
        wingGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(wingVertices, 3));
        wingGeo.computeVertexNormals();
        const wings = new THREE.Mesh(wingGeo, bodyMat);
        wings.scale.set(1.5, 1, 1);
        group.add(wings);

        scene.add(group);

        // Trail Line
        const trailSize = 30;
        const trailPositions = new Array(trailSize).fill(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0));
        const trailGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(trailPositions);
        const trailMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
            color: 0x00ffff,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
        });
        const trailLine = new THREE.Line(trailGeo, trailMat);
        scene.add(trailLine);
        
        robots.push({
            group,
            headGroup,
            eyesMaterial: glowMat,
            coreMaterial: glowMat,
            path: path,
            progress: startProgress,
            speed: 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.05,
            trailPositions,
            trailLine,
            isInteract: false,
            interactStartTime: 0
        });
    };

    const createYnoAssets = () => {
        const textureLoader = new THREE.TextureLoader();
        textureLoader.setCrossOrigin('anonymous');
        const ynoTexture = textureLoader.load('https://i.ibb.co/L5k5r6B/yno-coin-logo.png', () => {
            const logoMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                map: ynoTexture,
                transparent: true,
                blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
                depthWrite: false,
                side: THREE.DoubleSide
            });
            const logoGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 11.75); 
            ynoLogoPlane = new THREE.Mesh(logoGeometry, logoMaterial);
            ynoLogoPlane.scale.set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5);
            ynoLogoPlane.position.set(0, 15, -60); // Higher up
            scene.add(ynoLogoPlane);
        });
    };

    const animate = () => {
        animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        const delta = clock.getDelta();
        const time = clock.getElapsedTime();
        const { emotionalMode: currentMode } = stateRef.current;
        
        // Audio Analysis
        let currentVolume = 0;
        if (analyser.current) {
            analyser.current.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
            currentVolume = dataArray.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / dataArray.length;
        }
        const audioInfluence = Math.min(currentVolume / 50, 1.0);

        // Mode Switching
        const theme = modeThemes[currentMode];
        if (theme) {
            if (scene.fog) {
                const currentFog = scene.fog as THREE.FogExp2;
                currentFog.color.setHex(theme.sky);
                currentFog.density += (theme.fogDensity - currentFog.density) * 0.05;
            }
            scene.background = new THREE.Color(theme.sky);

            if (terrain1 && terrain1.material) (terrain1.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).emissive.setHex(theme.grid);
            if (terrain2 && terrain2.material) (terrain2.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).emissive.setHex(theme.grid);
            
            if (cyberSunGroup) {
                 const sunMesh = cyberSunGroup.children[0] as THREE.Mesh;
                 if (sunMesh && sunMesh.material) (sunMesh.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).color.setHex(theme.sun);
                 const rings = cyberSunGroup.children.slice(2);
                 rings.forEach(r => (r as THREE.Mesh).material && ((r as THREE.Mesh).material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).color.setHex(theme.sun));
            }
            
            robots.forEach(r => {
                r.eyesMaterial.color.setHex(theme.robot);
                r.eyesMaterial.emissive.setHex(theme.robot);
                (r.trailLine.material as THREE.LineBasicMaterial).color.setHex(theme.robot);
            });
        }

        const speedFactor = (currentMode === 'Enthusiastic' ? 2 : currentMode === 'Zen' ? 0.5 : 1) * (1 + audioInfluence);

        // --- ANIMATION: TERRAIN SCROLL ---
        const terrainSpeed = 15 * delta * speedFactor;
        if (terrain1 && terrain2) {
            terrain1.position.z += terrainSpeed;
            terrain2.position.z += terrainSpeed;

            if (terrain1.position.z > 50) terrain1.position.z = -450;
            if (terrain2.position.z > 50) terrain2.position.z = -450;
        }

        // --- ANIMATION: STARS ---
        if (stars) {
            stars.position.z += terrainSpeed * 0.5;
            if (stars.position.z > 100) stars.position.z = 0;
        }

        // --- ANIMATION: CYBER SUN ---
        if (cyberSunGroup) {
            cyberSunGroup.rotation.y += 0.005 * speedFactor;
            const sunMesh = cyberSunGroup.children[0];
            const scale = 1 + Math.sin(time) * 0.02 + audioInfluence * 0.2;
            sunMesh.scale.set(scale, scale, scale);
            
            // Rings rotation
            cyberSunGroup.children[2].rotation.z += 0.01;
            cyberSunGroup.children[3].rotation.z -= 0.02;
        }

        // --- ANIMATION: RISING DATA ---
        if (floatingData) {
            floatingData.position.y += 0.05 * speedFactor;
            if (floatingData.position.y > 10) floatingData.position.y = 0;
        }
        
        // --- ANIMATION: LOGO ---
        if (ynoLogoPlane) {
            ynoLogoPlane.rotation.y = Math.sin(time * 0.5) * 0.1;
            ynoLogoPlane.position.y = 15 + Math.sin(time) * 0.5;
        }

        // --- ANIMATION: ROBOTS ---
        robots.forEach(robot => {
            if (robot.isInteract) {
                const elapsed = time - robot.interactStartTime;
                if (elapsed < 1.0) {
                    robot.group.rotation.z += 0.3; 
                    robot.group.scale.setScalar(1.5);
                    robot.eyesMaterial.emissiveIntensity = 5 + (audioInfluence * 5); 
                } else {
                    robot.isInteract = false;
                    robot.group.scale.setScalar(1);
                    robot.group.rotation.z = 0;
                }
            } else {
                // FLIGHT PATH LOGIC
                const speedBoost = 1 + (audioInfluence * 4); // Stronger boost
                const step = (robot.speed * speedBoost * delta * speedFactor);
                robot.progress += step;
                if (robot.progress > 1) robot.progress = 0;

                const currentPos = robot.path.getPoint(robot.progress);
                
                // Look ahead for orientation
                const lookAtProgress = (robot.progress + 0.02) % 1;
                const lookAtPos = robot.path.getPoint(lookAtProgress);
                
                robot.group.position.copy(currentPos);
                robot.group.lookAt(lookAtPos);
                
                // Banking: Roll based on horizontal turn
                const tangent = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(lookAtPos, currentPos).normalize();
                const roll = -tangent.x * 1.5; // Simple banking approximation
                robot.group.rotation.z = roll;

                // Update Trail
                // Shift array
                for(let i = robot.trailPositions.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    robot.trailPositions[i].copy(robot.trailPositions[i-1]);
                }
                // Trail start point is engine position (local z 1.2 rotated)
                const engineWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1.2);
                engineWorldPos.applyMatrix4(robot.group.matrixWorld);
                robot.trailPositions[0].copy(engineWorldPos);
                
                robot.trailLine.geometry.setFromPoints(robot.trailPositions);
                // Fade trail opacity based on audio
                (robot.trailLine.material as THREE.LineBasicMaterial).opacity = 0.2 + audioInfluence * 0.5;

                // Eyes pulse
                const pulseFrequency = 3.0 + (audioInfluence * 15.0); 
                const baseIntensity = 1.5 + (audioInfluence * 5.0);
                const sinePulse = Math.sin(time * pulseFrequency);
                robot.eyesMaterial.emissiveIntensity = baseIntensity + (sinePulse * (0.5 + audioInfluence * 2.0));
            }
        });

        // Dynamic Camera Sway
        camera.position.x += (mouse.x * 3 - camera.position.x) * 0.02;
        camera.position.y += (3 + (-mouse.y * 2) - camera.position.y) * 0.02;
        camera.lookAt(0, 0, -30); // Look deeper into scene

        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };

    const onWindowResize = () => {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    };

    const onDocumentMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
        mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
    };
    
    const onMouseClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
        if (event.target !== renderer.domElement) return;

        mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;

        raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

        const robotGroups = robots.map(r => r.group);
        const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(robotGroups, true);

        if (intersects.length > 0) {
            let hitObject: THREE.Object3D | null = intersects[0].object;
            let targetRobot: Robot | undefined;

            while (hitObject) {
                targetRobot = robots.find(r => r.group === hitObject);
                if (targetRobot) break;
                hitObject = hitObject.parent;
            }

            if (targetRobot && !targetRobot.isInteract) {
                targetRobot.isInteract = true;
                targetRobot.interactStartTime = clock.getElapsedTime();
                playInteractionSound();
            }
        }
    };

    init();
    animate();

    window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onDocumentMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('click', onMouseClick);

    return () => {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onDocumentMouseMove);
        window.removeEventListener('click', onMouseClick);
        if (mountRef.current && renderer.domElement) {
           mountRef.current.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
        }
    };
  }, [videoRef]);

  return <div ref={mountRef} className="fixed top-0 left-0 w-full h-full z-0" />;
};

<content><![CDATA[import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import type { EmotionalMode } from '../types';

interface ThreeCanvasProps {
  analyser: React.MutableRefObject<AnalyserNode | null>;
  videoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement>;
  emotionalMode: EmotionalMode;
}

const ThreeCanvas: React.FC<ThreeCanvasProps> = ({ analyser, videoRef, emotionalMode }) => {
  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const stateRef = useRef({ emotionalMode });

  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current = { emotionalMode };
  }, [emotionalMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mountRef.current) return;

    let scene: THREE.Scene, camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera, renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer;
    let ynoLogoPlane: THREE.Mesh;
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    let animationId: number;
    
    // Environment Elements
    let terrain1: THREE.Mesh, terrain2: THREE.Mesh;
    let apeirogonGroup: THREE.Group;
    let stars: THREE.Points;
    let molecules: THREE.InstancedMesh;
    
    // New Particle System for Apeirogon
    let coreParticles: THREE.Points;
    let particleVelocities: Float32Array;
    
    const MOLECULE_COUNT = 200;
    
    // Robot definitions
    interface Robot {
        group: THREE.Group;
        headGroup: THREE.Group;
        eyesMaterial: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
        
        // Flight Path State
        path: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
        progress: number; // 0 to 1
        speed: number;
        
        // "Glob" Trail State
        trailGlobs: THREE.Mesh[]; // Array of spheres following the engine
        
        // Laser Tool
        laserMesh: THREE.Mesh;
        isFiring: boolean;

        // Interaction state
        isInteract: boolean;
        interactStartTime: number;
    }
    let robots: Robot[] = [];
    
    // Audio Data
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(256);

    // Color Themes matching the YNO Logo aesthetic
    const modeThemes: Record<EmotionalMode, { 
        sky: number, 
        grid: number, 
        core: number, 
        robot: number,
        laser: number
    }> = {
      Professional: { sky: 0x050510, grid: 0x4B0082, core: 0x00FFFF, robot: 0x00FFFF, laser: 0x00FFFF }, // Deep purple and cyan
      Enthusiastic: { sky: 0x1a0a00, grid: 0xFF4500, core: 0xFFD700, robot: 0xFFD700, laser: 0xFFD700 }, // Golden energy
      Cautious: { sky: 0x001a0a, grid: 0x006400, core: 0x00FF00, robot: 0x20B2AA, laser: 0x00FF00 },
      Zen: { sky: 0x101015, grid: 0xFFB6C1, core: 0xE6E6FA, robot: 0xFF69B4, laser: 0xFFC0CB }
    };

    const playInteractionSound = () => {
        try {
            const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
            const ctx = new AudioContext();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1200, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
            
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
            
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
        } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }
    };

    const init = () => {
      scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x050510);
      scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x050510, 0.012);

      camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
      camera.position.set(0, 5, 25);
      camera.lookAt(0, 5, -20);

      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
      if (mountRef.current) {
        mountRef.current.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
      }

      // Lights
      const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040, 2);
      scene.add(ambientLight);
      
      const coreLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffffff, 2, 150);
      coreLight.position.set(0, 15, -60);
      scene.add(coreLight);

      // --- ENVIRONMENT ---
      createStarfield();
      createInfiniteTerrain();
      createApeirogon(); 
      createCoreParticles(); 
      createMolecules(); 
      createYnoAssets();
      
      // --- ROBOTS (ONLY 2) ---
      const path1 = generateComplexPath(25, 12, 0); 
      const path2 = generateComplexPath(30, 18, Math.PI);
      
      createRobot(path1, 0.0);
      createRobot(path2, 0.5);
    };

    const createStarfield = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const count = 3000;
        const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
        
        for(let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            positions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 600;
            positions[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 300 + 50;
            positions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 500 - 100;
        }
        
        geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
        const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff,
            size: 0.4,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.6,
            sizeAttenuation: true
        });
        
        stars = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
        scene.add(stars);
    };

    const generateComplexPath = (width: number, height: number, offset: number): THREE.CatmullRomCurve3 => {
        const points: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
        const segmentCount = 14;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
            const t = (i / segmentCount) * Math.PI * 2 + offset;
            const x = Math.sin(t) * width + Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 8;
            const y = Math.cos(t * 1.5) * (height / 2) + 8; 
            const z = Math.cos(t) * 25 - 50; 
            
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
        }
        
        return new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
    };

    const generateTerrainGeometry = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(400, 400, 80, 80);
        geometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
        
        const positions = geometry.attributes.position.array as Float32Array;
        for(let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
            const x = positions[i];
            const distFromCenter = Math.abs(x);
            const height = Math.sin(x * 0.08) * 4 + Math.cos(x * 0.4) * 2 + (Math.random() * 1);
            positions[i + 1] = (distFromCenter > 25 ? height + (distFromCenter - 25) * 1.2 : height * 0.05) - 25;
        }
        geometry.computeVertexNormals();
        return geometry;
    };

    const createInfiniteTerrain = () => {
        const geometry = generateTerrainGeometry();
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: 0x000000,
            emissive: modeThemes.Professional.grid,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
            wireframe: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.25
        });

        terrain1 = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        terrain1.position.z = -100;
        
        terrain2 = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        terrain2.position.z = -500;

        scene.add(terrain1);
        scene.add(terrain2);
    };

    const createApeirogon = () => {
        apeirogonGroup = new THREE.Group();
        apeirogonGroup.position.set(0, 15, -70);
        scene.add(apeirogonGroup);

        // 1. Redesign based on the YNO Logo Theme
        // Outer Hexagonal Frame
        const hexPoints: THREE.Vector2[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 6;
            hexPoints.push(new THREE.Vector2(Math.cos(angle) * 12, Math.sin(angle) * 12));
        }
        const hexShape = new THREE.Shape(hexPoints);
        const hexExtrudeSettings = { depth: 2, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.5, bevelSize: 0.5 };
        const hexGeo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(hexShape, hexExtrudeSettings);
        const hexMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: 0x000000, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.1, 
            emissive: modeThemes.Professional.core, emissiveIntensity: 0.3 
        });
        const hexagonFrame = new THREE.Mesh(hexGeo, hexMat);
        apeirogonGroup.add(hexagonFrame);

        // Vertices Spheres (Nodes)
        const nodeGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.5, 32, 32);
        const nodeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: modeThemes.Professional.core, emissive: modeThemes.Professional.core, emissiveIntensity: 2 
        });
        hexPoints.forEach(p => {
            const node = new THREE.Mesh(nodeGeo, nodeMat);
            node.position.set(p.x, p.y, 1);
            apeirogonGroup.add(node);
        });

        // The Internal 'Y' Structure
        const yMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: 0xffffff, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 0.8, metalness: 1 
        });
        const branchGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 8);
        
        const centerY = new THREE.Mesh(branchGeo, yMat);
        centerY.position.set(0, -3.5, 1);
        apeirogonGroup.add(centerY);

        const leftY = new THREE.Mesh(branchGeo, yMat);
        leftY.position.set(-2.5, 3.5, 1);
        leftY.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 4;
        apeirogonGroup.add(leftY);

        const rightY = new THREE.Mesh(branchGeo, yMat);
        rightY.position.set(2.5, 3.5, 1);
        rightY.rotation.z = Math.PI / 4;
        apeirogonGroup.add(rightY);

        // Core Glowing Orb
        const coreOrb = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(4, 32, 32), nodeMat);
        coreOrb.position.z = 0;
        apeirogonGroup.add(coreOrb);
    };

    const createCoreParticles = () => {
        const count = 1200;
        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
        particleVelocities = new Float32Array(count * 3);

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            positions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
            positions[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
            positions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;

            const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.random()-0.5, Math.random()-0.5, Math.random()-0.5).normalize();
            const speed = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.2;
            particleVelocities[i * 3] = dir.x * speed;
            particleVelocities[i * 3 + 1] = dir.y * speed;
            particleVelocities[i * 3 + 2] = dir.z * speed;
        }

        geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
        const sprite = new THREE.TextureLoader().load('https://threejs.org/examples/textures/sprites/spark1.png');
        const material = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            color: modeThemes.Professional.core,
            size: 1.5,
            map: sprite,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.7,
            depthWrite: false
        });

        coreParticles = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
        apeirogonGroup.add(coreParticles);
    };

    const createMolecules = () => {
        const geometry = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.6, 0);
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: 0xffffff, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 0.6,
            transparent: true, opacity: 0.8 
        });

                }
            }

            robot.headGroup.rotation.y = mouse.x * 0.6;

        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    };

        mouse.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        mouse.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
